description: This custom visual provides a clear and intuitive way to track target achievement against planned values using a progress-bar KPI card. The visual displays progress toward a defined target in a compact format, allowing users to quickly identify whether metrics are below plan, on track, or exceeding expectations. It supports common KPI scenarios such as sales performance, budget tracking, and operational targets. Key capabilities: • Visual comparison of actuals vs planned or target values • Progress-bar representation for instant status recognition • Supports thresholds and conditional formatting • Suitable for KPIs such as sales, revenue, orders, utilization, or budget tracking Ideal for: • Target vs plan tracking • KPI monitoring and scorecards • Sales, finance, and operations reporting
